abstract: App-level security audit and hardening for Capacitor 8.5/9 apps: the Capgo scanner (@capgo/capgo-sec, capsec CLI), secrets in the web bundle, Keychain/Keystore token storage, HTTPS/ATS/cleartext, certificate pinning via CapacitorHttp, CSP and native bridge exposure through allowNavigation, Android manifest and iOS Info.plist review, screenshot protection, root/jailbreak detection, and live update bundle encryption. Xcode build-setting hardening lives in capacitor-ios-security-hardening.
